{{Top|leg}}
'''House Kallea''' was a noble house on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. Members of the house included [[Olun Kallea|Olun]] and [[Henne Kallea]], and their daughter [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]]. Freia's parents wished her to marry into a higher ranked house, though she had planned to apprentice in the [[Brentaal Spacefarers League]] to their disapproval. Kallea's best friend was whom she thought was a mild errand boy for [[House Brentioch]], but was in fact the [[Seneschal/Legends|seneschal]] [[Sival Brentioch]] of that house.
